name: concierge-google
description: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Tasks subagent via OAuth2. One-time interactive auth setup (google_auth_setup.py) is separate from the MCP server itself, which only ever loads the cached token.

client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Optional. Prefer GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the workspace .env.

client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
client_secret.description: Optional. Prefer GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in the workspace .env.
